name: needs-triage
description: New or changed work needs classification and scope review.

name: needs-info
description: Work needs an answer or evidence before it is ready.

name: ready-for-agent
description: Specified work is ready for an agent to execute.

name: ready-for-human
description: Joe or Dell must supply judgment or a needs-Joe answer.

name: safety-review
description: Work needs an explicit safety review before execution.

name: blocked
description: A named dependency prevents the next action.

name: wontfix
description: Work was deliberately withdrawn or declined.

name: superseded
description: Replacement work is linked; this item is no longer active.

name: failed
description: Execution ended unsuccessfully; failure evidence is recorded.

name: type:task
description: An engineering outcome owned by this repository.

name: type:slice
description: A bounded sub-issue of a parent engineering issue.
